entries.printed_type:
@PredictiveState.coarsest_exact : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {O : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} (T : A → X → X)
  (p : X → O) (c : X → R) (G : A → R → R) (d : R → O),
  Function.Surjective c →
    (∀ (x : X), d (c x) = p x) →
      (∀ (a : A) (x : X), c (T a x) = G a (c x)) →
        ∃ H,
          Function.Surjective H ∧
            (∀ (x : X), H (c x) = PredictiveState.encode T p x) ∧
              (∀ (a : A) (z : R), H (G a z) = PredictiveState.step T p a (H z)) ∧
                (∀ (z : R), PredictiveState.observe T p (H z) = d z) ∧
                  ∀ (K : R → PredictiveState.State T p), (∀ (x : X), K (c x) = PredictiveState.encode T p x) → K = H
